claim: The metal-trust discount tilt (F366202), as a daily forward paper record of its tilt book (PHYS/GLD and PSLV/SLV, z52 hysteresis, half the capital per pair) minus its static 25%-per-leg book, net of costs, continuing the recorded 2011-2026 books. Evidence for promotion or closure, decided by a pre-stated sequential test.

domain_rule.carried_state: per trust, the hysteresis state after the last stepped NAV observation and that observation's date; a session steps only observations dated after it and strictly before the session
domain_rule.costs: the domain's tiers: PHYS and PSLV at cef, GLD and SLV at tier1; books at 1x and stress_multiple x
domain_rule.execution: decided at a close, traded at the next close; 21 tranches, tranche k deciding on the sessions whose index from anchor_session is k mod 21

evaluation.at_a_promote_crossing: condition 2 or 4 failing: continue; a long leg <= 0: close as an issuance effect
evaluation.checks: on anniversaries of the window's opening only; readings in years 1-3 change nothing
corroboration: the long leg's summed contribution > 0 (held state > 0.5; held = mean of the last 21 lagged read states; contribution = (1/2)(held - 0.5)(r_trust - r_ETF), gross; tools/metal_trust_report.py)
at least 20 forward episodes (departures from neutral of the carried state inside the window; the carried-in state is not one)
evaluation.issuance_split: reported at each anniversary: sessions inside vs outside at-the-market windows, each from a SUPPL or 424B* filing (SEC submissions, the frozen CIKs, filingDate) to the expiry of the latest F-10 or F-10/A filed before it plus 25 months; inside share outside 10-90% reads degenerate
evaluation.route: a promotion triggers the decision debate on the forward-evidence route, whose boundary is LLR >= ln(m (1 - beta)/alpha), m = every forward watch ever frozen (route_policy)

identity.rule: a symbol change with the same CIK continues the watch (a symbol_change line); a CIK change is a VOID

nav_source.outage: no valid vintage for 63 consecutive sessions is a VOID; a shorter outage logs on the last vintage
nav_source.panel: cef_data.build_panel(tickers=[PHYS, PSLV], strict=True), observations private, manifest committed
nav_source.vintage_rule: a session reads the newest vintage fetched before the next session's close (20:00 UTC on its date), else the latest earlier one; a last observation more than 14 days old reads neutral

status: forward watch; not an admission candidate: gate rules v2 cannot admit it (0.022 x 23 ~ 0.51); promotion triggers a decision debate on the forward-evidence route
void_conditions: a trust or ETF delists, merges or changes CIK
a filed amendment to a trust's trust agreement or declaration that changes its redemption terms, cited by accession number
a change to GLD's or SLV's investment objective, cited by accession number
no valid NAV vintage for 63 consecutive sessions
window_opens: the first session after this spec reaches origin/development, dated by the first-parent merge commit that brought it there
